facts: Item 7 covers equipment associated with the milking parlour in a dairy farm setup.
Equipment shown under the milking parlour category includes milking cans, a portable milking machine, a digital weighing scale, and a freezer.
Milking cans serve as containers for handling, storing, or transporting harvested milk.
A portable milking machine is a mobile wheeled milking device utilized in dairy operations.
A digital weighing scale is used in the milking parlour setup to measure the weight/yield of milk accurately.
A freezer (chest type) is utilized in the milking parlour facility for cold storage preservation.
Item 8 covers the dairy farm's waste management facility.
Waste management facilities illustrated include vermicomposting and a waste treatment lagoon.
Vermicomposting uses earthworms to break down animal manure and organic farm waste into compost.
A waste lagoon is used for holding, settling, and biological treatment of liquid dairy manure and wastewater.
